explanation.en: Hale reports that “when one city made them compulsory, the number of people cycling fell by a third” → B. Berg also mentions a law, but she supports it and says nothing about a fall.
explanation.kk: Хейл: «when one city made them compulsory, the number of people cycling fell by a third» → B. Берг те заң туралы айтады, бірақ ол заңды қолдайды және азаю туралы айтпайды.
explanation.ru: Хейл сообщает: «when one city made them compulsory, the number of people cycling fell by a third» → B. Берг тоже говорит о законе, но она его поддерживает и о спаде не упоминает.

explanation.en: Chen believes “safer roads would do more for cyclists than any helmet law” → C. “Matters more” paraphrases “would do more”.
explanation.kk: Чен «safer roads would do more for cyclists than any helmet law» деп санайды → C. «Matters more» — «would do more» дегеннің басқаша айтылымы.
explanation.ru: Чен считает, что «safer roads would do more for cyclists than any helmet law» → C. «Matters more» пересказывает «would do more».
